focus.title: 欧盟加征电动汽车关税与美方实体清单扩围：中国出海企业面临双重贸易壁垒升级
focus.summary: 本周，欧盟正式宣布自7月起对中国进口电动汽车加征最高38.1%的临时反补贴关税，涵盖比亚迪、吉利、上汽等主要车企；美国商务部同步将13家中国实体列入出口管制实体清单，涉及半导体、量子计算等领域。两则动向标志着发达经济体对华贸易限制从传统商品向新能源、高科技产业链延伸，并呈现欧盟、美国、日本等多边协同趋势。中国企业需加速海外本地化布局与合规体系升级，以应对持续分化的全球市场准入条件。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会公告、美国联邦公报 · 2026年6月
focus.title_en: EU Imposes EV Tariffs and US Expands Entity List: Dual Trade Barriers Escalate for Chinese Overseas Companies
focus.summary_en: This week, the EU formally announced provisional anti-subsidy tariffs of up to 38.1% on Chinese electric vehicles starting July, targeting major automakers including BYD, Geely, and SAIC. Concurrently, the US Commerce Department added 13 Chinese entities to its export control entity list, covering semiconductors, quantum computing, and other fields. These moves indicate a coordinated expansion of trade restrictions from traditional goods to new energy and high-tech supply chains. Chinese enterprises must accelerate overseas localization and compliance upgrades to navigate increasingly fragmented market access conditions.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission announcement, US Federal Register · June 2026

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：跨境合资企业章程中“僵局条款”解释争议，强调善意谈判义务
case.summary: 本周，新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）就一起中资企业与东南亚合作伙伴的合资纠纷作出裁决。双方因经营战略分歧触发章程中的“僵局条款”，仲裁庭认定该条款要求双方在启动强制出售程序前履行“善意谈判”义务，仅形式化会议不满足要求。裁决援引联合国国际贸易法委员会（UNCITRAL）关于善意原则的评注，驳回了中方要求立即解散合资公司的请求，要求双方在60天内重新谈判。该案提示出海企业：合资协议僵局条款应明确谈判标准，避免因模糊措辞丧失主动权。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心 · 2026年6月
case.title_en: SIAC Award on Deadlock Clause in Cross-Border Joint Venture: Good Faith Negotiation Obligation Upheld
case.summary_en: This week, the Singapore International Arbitration Center (SIAC) ruled on a joint venture dispute between a Chinese company and a Southeast Asian partner. The tribunal held that the 'deadlock clause' in the JV charter requires both parties to engage in 'good faith negotiations' before invoking the forced sale mechanism, and that mere pro forma meetings are insufficient. Citing UNCITRAL commentaries on good faith, the tribunal denied the Chinese party's request for immediate dissolution and ordered 60-day renegotiation. The case underscores the need for clear negotiation standards in deadlock provisions to avoid losing leverage.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Center · June 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地：企业需建立数据出境安全评估常态化机制
policy.summary: 本周，广东省互联网信息办公室发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理规定（试行）》，明确自2026年8月1日起，大湾区内地九市向香港、澳门传输重要数据和个人信息须通过安全评估或适用标准合同备案。新规细化了“重要数据”目录、评估流程及时限（45个工作日），并首次将跨境金融、医疗、物流等场景的豁免条件制度化。企业应尽快梳理数据资产、完成合规差距分析，并关注后续配套指南。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026年6月
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Greater Bay Area: Enterprises Must Establish Routine Security Assessment Mechanisms
policy.summary_en: This week, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province issued the 'Provisions on the Management of Data Cross-Border Flow Security in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Trial)', effective August 1, 2026. The rules require that transfers of important data and personal information from nine mainland cities in the GBA to Hong Kong and Macao undergo security assessments or adopt standard contractual clauses. The provisions detail the 'important data' catalog, assessment timeline (45 working days), and for the first time institutionalize exemption conditions for cross-border financial, medical, and logistics scenarios. Enterprises should promptly inventory data assets, conduct compliance gap analyses, and monitor subsequent implementation guidelines.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · June 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：出海企业应建立“双轨”合规体系应对欧盟关税与数据新规叠加冲击
analysis.summary: 本周欧盟电动汽车关税与湾区数据新规同时落地，折射出出海企业面临的“贸易壁垒+数据主权”双重合规压力。建议企业：（1）对欧出口电动汽车相关企业立即启动供应链溯源与成本测算，评估通过第三国组装或技术授权规避部分关税的可行性；（2）涉及跨境数据传输的企业（尤其是金融、医疗、电商）应在8月前完成数据映射与安全评估预申请；（3）关注美国大选前可能进一步升级的出口管制，提前备货关键芯片与软件授权。下周重点关注：欧盟对华钢铁反补贴调查初裁、美国对东南亚光伏产品反倾销复审结果。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 律连全球 · 2026年6月
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Outbound Firms Should Establish 'Dual-Track' Compliance to Navigate EU Tariffs and Data Rules
analysis.summary_en: This week's EU EV tariffs and GBA data rules highlight dual compliance pressures of 'trade barriers + data sovereignty' for outbound enterprises. Recommendations: (1) EV exporters to the EU should immediately conduct supply chain traceability and cost analysis to assess partial tariff avoidance via third-country assembly or technology licensing; (2) firms involved in cross-border data transfers (especially finance, healthcare, e-commerce) should complete data mapping and pre-submit security assessment applications before August; (3) monitor potential escalation of US export controls before the election and pre-stock critical chips and software licenses. Next week's focus: EU's preliminary anti-subsidy ruling on Chinese steel, US anti-dumping review results on Southeast Asian photovoltaic products.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · iGlobal Law · June 2026
